name: 61401 · Galesburg, IL
findings: ZIP 61401 (Galesburg) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61401 (Galesburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61401 (Galesburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
